title: Weddings
source: User-provided workbook photo, manually transcribed; Word File German translations suggested separately

entries.description: The woman who is getting married
The long white clothes a woman often wears to marry
The man who is getting married
The jacket and trousers a man wears on the day he marries
A girl or young woman who helps the woman getting married
